items.name: media-storage-chart
items.title: Media Storage Chart
items.description: shadcn chart preset (recharts) for media storage bytes per category, with a base-1024 byte humanizer.

items.name: media-dashboard-overview
items.title: Media Admin Dashboard Overview
items.description: Media storage dashboard (stat cards + chart + subscriptions table) driven by the package's useMediaAdmin hook. Requires @mano8/astro-media-m8 installed.

items.name: media-maintenance-panel
items.title: Media Admin Maintenance Panel
items.description: Media admin danger zone (purge-stale / repair-orphans / purge-expired), each behind a shadcn alert-dialog confirmation, driven by useMediaAdmin. Requires @mano8/astro-media-m8 installed.

items.name: admin-media-dashboard
items.title: Admin Media Dashboard
items.description: Media admin view whose first/landing tab is the storage dashboard and whose destructive ops live in a guarded Maintenance tab; wraps the package's MediaProvider + RequireSuperuser. Requires @mano8/astro-media-m8 (and a fa-auth-m8 token adapter) installed.

items.name: media-category-tree
items.title: Media Category Tree
items.description: shadcn skin over astro-ui-m8's generic tree-view for the nested user category tree, with All/Uncategorized pseudo-nodes, driven by the package's useCategoryTree hook. Requires @mano8/astro-media-m8 installed.

items.name: media-library-tree
items.title: Media Library Tree View
items.description: Two-pane documents tree view: media-category-tree (left) paired with astro-ui-m8's data-table (right), scoped to the selected branch via the package's useMediaObjects hook. Requires @mano8/astro-media-m8 installed.

items.name: media-transfer-dialog
items.title: Media Import / Export Dialog
items.description: shadcn dialog skin for the media transfer hooks. It composes astro-ui-m8's dialog-form and data-table recipes, and forwards active filters such as a selected category branch. Requires @mano8/astro-media-m8 installed.
